inspiration: cozy indie pixel life sim; original assets only

rules: production sprites are emitted at final on-screen pixel dimensions
Phaser renderer scale for production sprites is always exactly 1
do not call setScale or setDisplaySize on production sprites
all production world art uses one shared authored pixel density
all hamster animation frames share one canonical visible scale and feet baseline
hamster frame scale drift fails the asset build
world sprites must be normalized before runtime
runtime must never hand-crop production sprite sheets
do not trim standardized cells after normalization
opaque pixels may not enter the protected gutter
collision derives from visible content bounds, not full transparent cell
